title: Phone top chrome
description: On a phone the top of the screen held a three-line status header (connection, version, round, phase, speaker, the turn banner), a row with the Technologies and Objectives buttons, a row of zoom buttons, the map view switch and the seat legend: 278 px of a 844 px screen before the map even started, and on a landscape phone 207 of 390 px. On a phone (up to 720 px wide or up to 500 px tall) all of that is now one 40 px bar: connection dot, round and phase, a short status (YOUR TURN, Waiting: Player 2, ...), the version and a menu button. The menu button carries a dot when a decision waits for you (amber), when it is only your turn (blue) or when the link is down (red). The menu opens a bottom sheet with the full status, the zoom buttons, the map view switch, who's who and the Technologies and Objectives buttons, all 44 px targets. Pinch is the browser's: the map has no pinch handler of its own, so the zoom buttons moved into the sheet. Desktop (and a phone asking for the desktop site, over 720 px wide and 500 px tall) is unchanged. The before shots are taken on the commit without the change and committed (before/measure.txt has the measurements); the after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BD. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: your turn, 390x844
shots.caption: The map starts 278 px down (140 px status header, 138 px toolbar rows). The action pane starts at 450 px and covers 175 px of the 347 px high map: only the top half of the galaxy is visible.

shots.heading: After: your turn, 390x844
shots.caption: The map starts at 40 px and ends above the action pane: the whole galaxy is visible (347 px, none under the pane). The amber dot on the menu button says a decision waits for you.

shots.heading: Before: waiting for another player, 390x844
shots.caption: Same 278 px of chrome; 144 px of the map lie under the pane.

shots.heading: After: waiting for another player, 390x844
shots.caption: 40 px bar: 'R2 · Action', 'Waiting: Player 2', version, menu button without a dot.

shots.heading: Before: pending decision (dialog minimized), 390x844
shots.caption: A decision for you, minimized to its pill; the header is still 140 px plus the 138 px toolbar rows.

shots.heading: After: pending decision (dialog minimized), 390x844
shots.caption: The bar is the same 40 px; the amber dot on the menu button and the Resume decision pill say a decision waits.

shots.heading: Before: your turn, 360x740
shots.caption: 156 px header plus 138 px toolbar rows: the map starts 294 px down and only 52 px of its 321 px are above the pane.

shots.heading: After: your turn, 360x740
shots.caption: The map starts at 40 px; 306 of its 321 px are above the pane (before: 52).

shots.heading: Before: waiting, 360x740
shots.caption: Header 140 px and toolbar rows 138 px.

shots.heading: After: waiting, 360x740
shots.caption: One 40 px bar; the whole 321 px map is above the pane.

shots.heading: Before: your turn, landscape 844x390
shots.caption: 207 px of chrome on a 390 px screen: the map (75 px tall) is hidden behind the toolbar rows and the pane.

shots.heading: After: your turn, landscape 844x390
shots.caption: 40 px bar; the map is 242 px tall, 124 px of it above the pane (before: none).

shots.heading: Before: waiting, landscape 844x390
shots.caption: Same 207 px of chrome.

shots.heading: After: waiting, landscape 844x390
shots.caption: 40 px bar; 186 px of the map visible (before: 19).

shots.heading: Menu open: your turn, 390x844
shots.caption: Bottom sheet, reachable with the thumb: full status line, Zoom + / - / reset, View (Standard and the four overlays), Who's who, Technologies and Objectives. Every control is at least 44 px high.

shots.heading: Menu open: waiting, 390x844
shots.caption: Same sheet while waiting; no dot on the button.

shots.heading: Menu open: 360x740
shots.caption: The overlay buttons wrap onto two rows; nothing scrolls sideways.

shots.heading: Menu open: landscape 844x390
shots.caption: Two columns: status and the Technologies / Objectives buttons on the left, zoom, view and who's who on the right; the sheet fits without scrolling.

shots.heading: Before: Resources and influence view, 390x844

shots.heading: After: Resources and influence view, 390x844
shots.caption: Chosen from the menu (View) and the sheet closed: the map shows the economy overlay under the slim bar.

shots.heading: After: zoomed in from the menu, 390x844
shots.caption: Two zoom steps from the sheet; the zoom state stays in the map when the sheet closes.

shots.heading: After: desktop site on a phone, 980x740
shots.caption: Unchanged (header 47 px, toolbar rows 98 px, map from 145 px: identical measurements).
